page.layout: One page of text. The running head is at the top. Below it: the continuation of a paragraph, then a centred italic salutation, a centred italic motto over two lines, the author's signature at lower centre, and "Pauli" at lower right.

main_text.p: mem diutissimè conseruet: Datum kalendis Aprilibus, Anno CHRISTI MDXC.
M. Iacobus Christmannus Hebraæ linguæ Professor.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible across the page and was not transcribed. The date "cIↄ Iↄ xc." is converted to MDXC as instructed. The long s in "Celsitudini", "obstrictus", "Christmannus" and "Professor" is rendered as plain s.
